messages:
Maya (People Ops): quick q — an IC is moving countries for ~2 months and asked whether we should do a monthly WFH allowance or pay a one-time equipment reimbursement. any pros/cons from payroll/tax perspective?
Alex (Eng): which country and are they staying on Redwood payroll or contracting locally?
Maya (People Ops): staying as Redwood employee, still on US payroll, travel is to Malaysia for ~8 weeks, working remotely for that period.
Jordan (Manager): they're keeping full-time hours, just remote for the stint. manager ok with it.
Sam (Payroll): short answer: it depends. recurring stipends are treated as taxable income on payroll; one-off reimbursements can be treated as expense reimbursements if properly documented, but local tax residency/rules matter.
Maya (People Ops): ok — what's the checklist we need from the employee to make a safe call?
Sam (Payroll): need exact dates, country, home base, and confirmation they're not doing local contracting. then we run our tax nexus/PE check and confirm withholding. also need invoice/receipt for gear if we reimburse as expense.
Alex (Eng): is there a threshold where equipment reimbursement becomes taxable regardless?
Sam (Payroll): many countries treat employer-paid equipment as a taxable benefit unless it's clearly for business and owned by company. if we purchase and retain ownership (company asset) it's cleaner. if we reimburse a personal purchase, we should collect receipts + asset transfer doc.
Maya (People Ops): good note — so option A: company purchases and ships laptop to them (company asset) for duration; option B: one-time stipend cash -> payroll (taxable); option C: expense reimbursement with receipts (may be taxable depending on country).
Jordan (Manager): logistics-wise option A simplest for compliance but slower. can we do express shipping?
Sam (Payroll): we can, but need asset tag + return plan. also lodge a short Travel/Location note in HR so benefits and insurance coverage know.
hr-bot: Reminder — please have employee submit Work Location Change form: https://intranet/redwood/hr/forms (include dates and temporary address).
Maya (People Ops): action items: (1) Maya to confirm dates + temp address with employee, (2) Sam to run payroll/tax check for Malaysia given US payroll, (3) Ops to evaluate shipping timeframe if company laptop chosen.
Alex (Eng): +1. I'll flag to ops for shipping estimate.
Sam (Payroll): will run the check by EOD tomorrow and post summary here. if it looks risky we recommend payroll-stipend route to avoid misclassification.
Maya (People Ops): perfect — thanks everyone :raised_hands: we want to be helpful but also keep taxes clean.
Jordan (Manager): thanks!
Maya (People Ops): marking this resolved for now, will follow up with final rec after Sam's check.
